helpAcknowledged: Got it — do not remind me automatically
storageError: This browser could not save the draft. Your unsaved changes are still here.
previewHint: Preview updates as you edit. Choose Save changes to update your portfolio.
empty: Nothing here yet. Add your first entry.
hideHint: Hiding keeps the entry in your draft.
tenureHint: Work tenure is calculated from work dates; education is excluded.
basicHint: Tell visitors where you worked or studied and what you did.
experienceContentHint: Describe your responsibilities, impact and outcomes.

skillsHint: Choose shared skills for experience and projects.
detailHint: For a teaching assistant, instructor or other role held during this experience.
dateHint: Month is enough. An optional day appears in the public date.

discardHint: Your draft will return to its last saved version.
introHint: Your name and a few words about what you do.
socialHint: Only completed links appear in the preview.
otherHint: Complete your footer and the introduction bubble.
introPreviewHint: Shown in Overview, contact links, the footer and introduction bubble.
stopsHint: Ordered by start date, matching Journey playback.
coordinatesHint: Choose coordinates on the map; the city name is shared with Experience and Journey.
categoryHint: Drag grips to reorder. Swipe a category left or use ⋯ to reveal Delete.
skillLibraryHint: Skill names are shared. Renaming updates every experience and project that uses the skill.
skillsPreviewHint: See how this category appears on your public portfolio. The preview updates as you edit.
noUses: No experience or project uses this skill yet.
projectHint: The summary appears on the project card; details appear when it is opened.
projectDetailsHint: Explain the workflow, your contribution and what changed.
validationTitle: Check the highlighted fields before saving.
errorDuplicate: Another skill already uses this name.

errorDay: Enter a valid day for the end month.
errorCoordinate: Enter a valid latitude or longitude.
errorUrl: Enter a complete http or https URL.
skillExists: That skill already exists. Select it from the library.
reorderHint: Drag the grip to reorder, or focus it and use the arrow keys. Escape cancels a drag.
skillsSortHint: Drag skill grips to arrange the display order. Arrow keys also work.
dragging: Dragging {{name}}. Release to place; Escape to cancel.
mapHint: Click the map or drag the pin to choose a location. Confirm when it is in the right place.
mapKeyboard: Drag to move, scroll or pinch to zoom. Keyboard: arrow keys to pan, + / − to zoom, then use the map center.
mapUnavailable: The local map data could not load. Try again.
mapCoordinateHint: This sets the map marker. City and country names are edited in the form.
mapSearchEmpty: No matching city. Try another name or choose directly on the map.
mapOfflineHint: Bundled world boundaries and city locations. No street or building details; no internet connection required.
locationHint: Set the city and map position for this experience. Preview its place in the journey alongside the form.
careerDisplayHint: Shows this entry on Experience and Journey. Hiding keeps it in your draft.
noRoute: Your visible experiences will appear here in chronological order.
sourceError: Your existing portfolio could not load. Your saved browser draft has not been changed.
apiSource: Your portfolio · {{count}} projects, including hidden content.
emptySource: No content yet. Add your introduction, experience, projects and skills.
legacySource: A previous browser draft is open. Your server portfolio contains {{count}} projects. Load it to replace this working copy, or review your changes before saving.
importHint: Load the latest server content into the editor. Unsaved changes in the working copy will be replaced.
saveError: The portfolio could not be saved. Your changes remain in the editor.
saveConflict: Your portfolio changed elsewhere. Your edits are still here; reload the latest server content before saving again.
saveForbidden: Your current permissions do not allow these changes. Your edits are still here.
saveCommitted: Changes were committed, but the public cache could not refresh. Reload the server content to confirm the saved result.
saveUnknown: The save result could not be confirmed. Keep your edits and reload the server content before submitting again.
readOnly: Your account can view this content. Update permission is required to save changes.
countrySelectionHint: Choose a city or a point on land so its country can be identified offline.
descriptionShowcase: Preview your current edits together, in the order and language visitors will see.
showcaseEmpty: No content is currently set to display.
deleteProjectsHint: Remove {{count}} selected project(s) from this draft? Shared skills and experiences will remain. Save changes to apply the deletion.
projectLoadError: This project page could not load. Your edits are preserved. Retry, or reload server content if its version has changed.
previewIncomplete: Some unfinished dates or locations cannot be displayed yet. Complete those fields in the editor to include them in this preview.
deleteExperiencesHint: Remove {{count}} selected experience(s) from this draft? Projects and shared skills will remain; only their experience links are cleared. Save changes to apply the deletion.
